description: This file defines interfaces for an event threading system, including factory and thread classes, with methods for creating threads, adding event handlers, and flushing events.

classes.name: IEventThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IEventThread, providing methods to create factory and event thread objects.

classes.name: IEventThread
classes.description: Interface for an event thread, allowing adding event handlers and flushing events.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a shared pointer to an IEventThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates a new IEventThread instance with an optional thread name.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes any waiting events in the thread.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event handler function to the thread, with support for functions with arguments via templates.
